batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c JD Ryder b WD Parnell

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c A Nehra b WD Parnell

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c MK Tiwary b Iqbal Abdulla

batting.name: MJ Clarke
batting.dismissal: st BB McCullum b YK Pathan

batting.name: AP Majumdar
batting.dismissal: st BB McCullum b Shakib Al Hasan

batting.name: CJ Ferguson
batting.dismissal: c JH Kallis b R Bhatia

batting.name: WD Parnell
batting.dismissal: c LR Shukla b L Balaji

balls.text: yorker length yet again, taken on the full, tries to hit it over the top, toe end of the bat, to long-on where they come back for the second
outside the off stump, fuller and driven to point for a single
outside the off stump, pitched up to the bat, 141.6 km/hr, superb ball, but he over-steps and that is  Free Hit for Tiwary
outside the off stump, pushed to the deep covers for a single, only four from the first four balls and not too many changes of pace
yorker yet again, quick too, 142.7 km/hr and he can only tap it away for a single
pitched up yet again, outside the off stump and this time he connects, but not off the middle, goes to mid-wicket for a couple of run
on the off stump, wanted to go over the top but misses the ball completely, it was a quicker one as well
wants to hoick away a length ball from outside the off stump, misses
full-toss on the middle stump, driven straight back, as straight as it could go, hitting the non-striker's stumps and they can get only a single. Pathan would think a boundary was stolen there
yet again, on the pads, flicked away to the fence for a four, the fine-leg was up in the circle
on the leg stump, pitched right up, tries to flick it away, misses, hits the pads

pitched up on the off stump, driven to long-off, it was running away but well fielded by Majumdar , throws it to the fielder running from long-on...third umpire called in to look at it and the foot was touching the boundary
dropped? Decent attempt at mid-wicket, and not too many would have caught that one, jumping fully up, to that powerfully flicked stroke, Ganguly the fielder
shorter ball, slower too, wants to pull it away, gets it to the mid-wicket fielder on the bounce
yorker, on off stump, missed, bowled! For a change, this was a quicker one from Kumar, tries to dig the ball away but Shakib fails in that endeavour, cleaned up
full pitched, outside the off stump, driven to extra-cover for a single
slower yet again, tries to hit it hard, into the pitch, to long-off
outside the off stump, slower, rolling his fingers over, pushed to the off side for a quick single
full-toss on the middle stump, he tries to flick it away but barely gets any timing on it, goes to square-leg for a single
on the middle stump, moves to outside the off stump and flicks it away to deep square-leg, the fielder moves to his left to field and throw it back
pitched up, driven down the ground, Clarke fields well from mid-off but they are through for a single
he was attempting a paddle sweep over fine-leg, it was outside the off stump, changed his shot and opened the face of the bat, goes to fine third-man where Murtuza dives to save it
pitched up, outside the off stump, driven to the deep fielder at the covers
gives himself room and tries to slog it over the mid-wicket, mistimes it to the leg side
outside the off stump, wants to play it over the in-field, but gets no timing on it and he can only drill it straight to extra-cover, who is right back on the circle
reverse sweep off a fast bowler, gets it off the middle but to the short third-man fielder, who had turned into a short fine-leg fielder when he played that shot
was going down the track, length of the ball is shortened and he is only able to pull it to long-on for a single
yorker length ball, on the pads, tries to play it away to fine-leg, gets an edge to the off side and they get a single
slogs again, as ugly as some of the shots have looked, they have been productive and this one gets him a single to deep square-leg
pitched right up to the bat, on the off stump, slogged it away to wide long-on, comes back for the second
outside the off stump, pitched right up to the bat, driven to point for no run
tries to pull it away, gets an inside edge and misses
outside the off stump, length ball and punched to the off side, straight to the fielder at short cover
goes across his stumps and tries to scoop it over the fine-leg, gets an inside edge to the off side
fours continue to rain here, tries to cut away a slower one, gets a bottom edge and it goes through the keeper for a four
that was full-pitched yet again and he has drilled it over mid-wicket for four, no real back-lift for him there
length ball, on the middle stump, slower too, he tries to drive it through covers, gets early into the stroke and it goes to long-on for a single
moves around in the crease, and then stabilises himself before the ball arrives, flicks it to the fine, fine-leg region for a four, excellent batting from Shakib
on the off stump, tries to swing it away, inside edge on to the pads, rolls away to the off side
slower ball on the pads, length too and he has swept it away for four, there was a short fine-leg in the circle and he merely watched the inevitable
shorter from Ganguly and it goes lower, he was trying to pull it away and was into his stroke way before the ball arrived, hits the toe
on the off stump, keeps low too, opens the face of the bat and to backward point for a single
outside the off stump, tapped it to the off side for a single
full pitched yet again and he gets it right in the middle of the bat and heaves it over mid-wicket for the second six of the over!
round the stumps, full toss and driven to long-off for a single
slog swept away and dropped by Parnell at deep square-leg!
and again, down the pitch, driven to long-on for a couple
runs down the track yet again, this time he gets some bat on it and that has cleared the mid-wicket fielder for a six
and that is a third in a row, the ball turned a mile and beats the batsman, beats the keeper too! Stumping missed!
down the track yet again and it has flat-batted over mid-wicket for another four, woohoo! Two fours in a row on this track is big!
short ball, from round the stumps and pulled it away for a four to fine-leg, the fielder there had no chance to stop it
outside the off stump, comes down the track and cuts it to deep covers for a single
round the stumps, goes down the pitch and tries to thrash it away, mistimes to mid-off and they go through for a quick single
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat through to third-man for a single
angling into the left-hander, tries to drive it through the leg side but goes to the fielder
fuller this time from Clarke and that is driven down the ground for a single
outside the off stump, some room to play the sweep, but it keeps low and misses
on the back foot, quickish, tapped away to the leg side for a single
on the off stump, shorter and he gets some turn out of that one, played away to the deep square-leg for a single
full-toss on the off stump, driven to long-off for a single
round the stumps, angling in and defended back to the bowler
outside the off stump, driven but to the right of Ganguly at short-cover and he fields well
outside the off stump, punched down the ground to long-off
outside the off stump, driven to deep covers, they go for a run and then decide to go for the second, the throw comes in really quick, had that hit direct, could have been curtains
length ball on his pads as well, works it away to the leg side for a single to get off the mark
short of length, the batsman is on the back foot but the ball never rises above his knees, defended back
on the middle stump, slower as well, length ball and pushed to long-off for a single
pitched right up to the batsman, who drives it hard and back to the bowler, Clarke fields and throws it back to the wicket-keeper, just before the umpire has called for the Time-Out
on the back foot, flicked away to square-leg

tries an inside-out shot, misses and bowled! He had tried playing this of the first ball of the over as well, and got a single, this time he tried to hit it rather hard, the ball almost did not arrive and he failed to connect, hits the middle stump
outside the off stump, tapped to the off and Kallis wanted a single, the non-striker was having nothing of it
goes down the track and driven to long-off for a single
round the stumps and on the middle, fuller and driven inside out to the sweeper for a single
full ball on the off stump and driven to long-off for a single
on the middle stump, short of length, pushed to long-on for a single
on the off stump, length ball, pushed to the sweeper for a single
slower ball outside the off stump, floated up as well, goes for a whack over mid-wicket but mistimed
length ball, outside the off stump, pushed down to long-off, single but vitally it is called for over-stepping
on the pads, fuller, driven to short mid-wicket
outside the off stump, length ball, slower one, pushed to the covers
round the stumps, on to the middle stump and plonks his foot out and defends it back to the bowler
outside the off stump, fuller and driven to sweeper for one again
on the pads, but he can only drive it to the long-on for a single
angling in, full-toss and driven to long-off
on the pads, fullish and driven to long-on for a single
round the stumps, pitched right up, driven to the sweeper for a single
slower one, outside the off stump, the third-man was up in the circle and comes in action immediately as Kallis opens the face of the bat and guides it to him
outside the off stump, length ball and keeps low, manages to get it away to point
on the off stump, short of length, defended to the off side in the in field
width and he stands up tall, majestically and drives it through the covers! It was pitched up too
another one outside the off stump, fuller as well, driven to mid-off once again
on the off stump, fuller and driven back to the bowler, fielded well
pitched right up to the batsman, outside the off stump and he throws his bat at it, still cannot pierce the gap and it goes to extra-cover
on the off stump, short of length, pushed to the off side and to the fielder
on the leg stump, short of length, pushed to mid-on and by the time the fielder comes in to stop it, they are off for a single
gone, caught at mid-on! It was pitched up by Parnell and Gambhir spanked it, probably in an attempt to clear the in-field, did not get sufficient elevation and Nehra takes a wobbly catch at mid-on
short of length, on the off stump, pushed to gully and again, they do not get a run
outside the off stump, pitched up to the bat and cut away, goes to the fielder at backward point
steps down the track, flicks it away to square-leg for a single
punctured it through the umbrella on the off side, it was a shorter one, GG rocks back and that speeds away
outside the off stump, fuller yet again and driven to the long-off for a single
on his pads, fuller, driven to mid-on
inside edge to a cut, they wanted a single, then they did not, confusion all around, Gambhir rushed back to his position at the non-striker's end before the throw came in
round the stumps, angling in, defended back to the bowler
on the middle stump and pitched right up to the bat, dabbed to the off side and they are off for a really quick single
goes down the track, tries to force it through the covers, hits it straight to the fielder at covers
on the middle stump, despite the fielder being brought up inside the circle, flicked away and goes straight to that fielder, only a single
outside the off stump, fuller as well, driven to the covers and that gets him no run
on the middle stump and he has swung it across the line, lucky to get some bat on that one, to square-leg
on the off stump, pitched up as well, defended away to point
on the middle stump, driven to deep mid-wicket for a single
short of length, flicked away by GG to deep mid-wicket and by the time the long-on fielder came around, they are through for a second
flighted slightly, slower, comes on to the front foot, defended on the front foot, inside edge to square-leg
another one, round the wickets, pitched outside off, angling in, pushed back
on the off stump, takes his front foot out and defended away to the off side
outside the off stump, pitched up and driven to long-on for a single
down the track and boundary, the ball was outside the off stump and he shimmied down and flicked it over mid-on for a four
outside the off stump, on a length and left alone by McCullum
outside the off stump, fuller this time and driven through the covers for a four, finally a run on the board
walks out down the track, bit of a swing, hits the pads and there was an appeal there, not-out this time
swinging into the batsman yet again, pitched fuller, on the off stump and defended straight to the left of the bowler
on the middle stump, bit of swing into the bat, nudged away to square-leg
off spin this time, played away to the off side for a single, Kolkata win with ease
leg spin, and a lot of it, hits the pads, fails to read it again
short of length, leggie, punched down the ground for a single
similar length, line, and this time it turns away from the bat, beaten again!
outside the off stump, shorter and turning into the batsman, wants to drive it, misses
goes down the track, hits it inside out to sweeper and they get a single
outside the off stump, very slow, almost does not reach the batsman, manages to dab it away to the off side for a single
outside the off stump, pitched right up to the bat, inside edged to the keeper
on the middle stump, short of length, flicked it away to the leg side for a single

on the off stump, tries to play it inside out, chipped in the air and Shukla runs to his right and takes a very good catch. It was a slower ball and he wanted to check the shot there, but could not keep it on the ground
on the middle stump, punched to the off side for a single
on the off stump, punched to the sweeper for a single
leg-spinner, quicker too and defended on to the leg side
gone, caught and bowled! that was shorter too, on the off stump, the batsman was looking to work it over some place on the leg side but all he can do is to afford a simple catch back to Narine.
goes for the almighty heave, can only get a bottom edge for a single
on his pads, flicked to the leg side and they are away for another single
pushes it to the off side, gets a single to get off the mark
quicker, on the off stump, not too much turn, tries to cut it away, missed
finally gets something on his bat and yet, it can only go as far as long-on for a decently well-judged catch from Kallis, was pitched up and he does not get the timing right
on the leg stump, very slow too, tries to drive it to the leg side but misses timing it, hits the pads
tries to pull it away, to long-on for a single
leg-spinner, even the ones on which he is rolling the fingers over are gripping and turning and played away to the leg side
outside the off stump, pitched up, slower as well, tries to drive it away, gets the outside edge and goes to short third-man
on the leg stump, short of length, works it away to the leg side and they are able to come back for the second run
on the middle stump, punched down the ground to bring a single and the Time-Out

gone, down the wicket, missed, stumped! It was outside the off stump, coming in with the angle and turning away from the batsman from that angle, he went down the track in an attempt to bring down the high asking rate, missed completely and is stumped
on the middle stump again, comes in with the angle, driven to long-on
on the middle, keeps very low, tries to pull it away, gets bit of an inside edge to the fine-leg
shorter and that is pulled away to fine-leg for a single
short of length, goes down the track and slams it back, over the bowler, but its gone to long-on for a single
shorter from the bowler and he horizontal bats it to long-on for a single
on the pads, pitched up, tries to drive it to the long-on, gets an inside-edge to the bowler
short, outside the off stump, finally gets a good shot going through extra-cover, and they can get a couple of runs to wide long-off
on the off stump, punched to the covers for a quick single
on the off stump, short of the length, pushed to mid-wicket for a single
outside the off stump, tries to cut it away hard, can only get it away to deep covers for a single
quicker, and this has turned a mile but unlike the last one, it has gone away from the batsman, how do you play those, not too many would know.
shorter on the off stump and moving away from the batsman, pushed to long-on for a single
pitched right up to the batsman, driven to wide long-on for a couple of runs, the long-on fielder rushes across to get to the ball
shorter from Narine, turning away, punched down the ground to long-on
turn, bounce and the cut shot was never happening, it was coming in a long distance
short of length, played away to the off side but to the fielder
slower one, misses the stroke and it hits the pads, loud, loud appeal, but the umpire thinks it is going down the leg side, given not out and they are off for a leg-bye
outside the off stump, cuts it away to the deep point region for a single
slower again, pitched up to the batsman, defended to the off side
nearly spoons it up to short covers, slower one, bit of bounce and it could have easily gone to hand
slower one, rolls his fingers over that one, plays it to the off side
outside the off stump, room to cut, gets the stroke going but to the point fielder
very full this time and he is able to flick it away for a single
on the middle, he was going back to defend that one, played to the leg side
another one, pitched n middle and going away from the bat, he was trying to defend but missed
turn and it keeps really low! pitched outside the leg-side, and rips away!
goes down the track, gets an outside edge, loops up in the air but away from the fielder at short covers
shorter from Abdulla, from round the stumps, turning away from the bat, flicked to mid-wicket and they are able to come back for the second
goes down the track and drives it gracefully through the covers to the deep fielder, only a single
round the stumps, goes on to the front foot, pushes it to the covers, Gambhir ran up from point and rips it to the non-striker's end, misses

gone, in front! It was from round the stumps, pitching on the middle and going through, misses the bat and hits the front pad, Ganguly wasn't happy with the decision, but it looked like going on to hit the stumps
on the off stump, flicked away to deep square-leg for a single
on the off stump too, turns away from the batsman and played down to the off side
outside the off stump, short of length, punched to the covers
driven down the ground to long-on for a single
on his pads, flicks it away to deep fine-leg, it was running away to the fence before Bhatia comes around and stops the ball
on the leg side, flicked it away to deep square-leg for a single
short of length, on the off stump, punched to the covers, it was quicker too
bowled him! On the middle stump, tries to pull it away, it turned away from the bat from round the stumps, and once Ryder had missed that one, the ball takes the castle off, he's walking away
pitched up to the batsman, on the leg side, tapped away to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump, length ball, wants to cut it away but absolutely no timing on it, through to point. And speaking of timing, its time for Time-Out
outside the off stump, length ball, opens the face of the bat, through to third-man for a single
shorter from Balaji, wanted to pull it away, misses it, falls short of keeper, fumbled and they are off for a run
short of a good length, outside the off stump, pulls it away to deep square-leg for a single
outside the off stump, pitched up too but the ball keeps low, it is pushed to point, 117.2 km/hr
outside the off stump, pitched up, pushed to the off side
slower one, Ryder wanted to play it to the leg side but misses it, hits his back pad, but high
on the middle stump, punched down the ground for a single

gone stumped? Stumping appeal here, the batsman was out of his crease but the ball was not in the hands at the end of the sequence, luckily for the keeper, the ball came out of his hands after he had dislodged the bails, wide called too! The ball was on the middle stump, he came down the track, it turned away and the batsman missed it
outside the off stump, quicker too, late cut away for a couple of runs
outside the off stump, goes down the track, flicks it away to the leg-side
round the stumps, angling in, pushed to long-on for a single
flights it up outside the off stump, driven to the deep square-leg for a single
on the off stump, pushes it to the mid-off and they are off for a single
outside the off stump, 130.8 km/hr and tries to cut it away, misses the shot
outside the off stump, tries to cut it away, gets an outside edge through to the fine third-man for a single
on the stumps, pitched fuller too, driven to long-on for a single
on the middle stump, coming in with the angle, slower as well, flicked away to square-leg and follows it up with a 'Wait On!'
shorter from Balaji and easily pulled away to deep square-leg for a single
down the leg side, lets it go and it is a wide, McCullum fumbles as well and they get a couple of wides

goes down the track, the ball was turning into him and not away and is able to tap it back to the bowler, many a great men have been sold a dummy to that away going ball from Narine when they have come down the pitch
quicker, outside the off stump, cut away to the fielder
inside out against Narine, it was outside the off stump and Ryder sees it through on to his bat, over the in field and takes a couple
opens the face of the bat, through to point and they get a single
slower and very short, it almost disappeared somewhere on the pitch, misses and through to the keeper
outside the off stump, driven to the mid-wicket region, where the batsmen are able to come back for the second
on the off stump, wants to drive it to mid-off, inside edge gets it to mid-on and they get a single
on the middle stump, flicked away to mid-wicket for a single, Tiwary gets in from deep and throws the stumps down direct at the striker's end
on the leg stump and turns viciously down the leg side, he was trying to sweep it away, misses but that is a wide
pitched up to the bat, gets his foot down and drives to mid-on for a single
played it away to the leg side for a single
superb, superb shot on this pitch, outside the off stump, he goes down the track and plays it inside out, not too much aggression, a lot of timing and it goes over long-on
on the middle stump, shorter, quicker, flicked away with quick hands to the deep square-leg region for a single
on the leg stump, pushed away to mid-on for a quick single
quicker, on the off stump, turning away and defended on the off side
round the stumps, angling in and turns away from the batsman, keeps low too, simply unplayable!
shorter this time, flicked it away to mid-wicket for a single
down the track and smacks it over mid-wicket for a six! There was a fielder and he watches it sail over
pitched fuller, the ball keeps a tad low as well, tries to work it away but to the fielder on the leg side
on the middle stump, turning away, defended on the front foot and to the bowler
shorter yet again, but plenty of turn for the bowler, flicked away, was in the air and in the gap, for a single
short, on his pads, flicked away to square-leg
shorter, spinning away, pushed down the track, misfielded by the bowler, single to long-off

flighted, lobbed up and caught! He was coming from round the stumps, Uthappa was trying to drive it through the covers, the ball probably did not come on to the bat, checked his stroke at the very last moment, by which time the ball had already looped up from his bat and the man deep in the covers, but within the circle has the easiest of catches
round the stumps, shorter, wanted to cut it away, pushed only to the covers
shorter ball from Shakib, wanted to pull it away but the slowness of the track and the turn that Shakib gets beats the stroke and all he gets is a shot to square-leg
shorter, keeps low as well, punched to mid-off, misfielded by Abdulla, allows a single
round the stumps angling in and rips across the batsman from there, missed totally
turning into the batsman, gets an inside edge and through to short fine-leg, able to take off for a single
goes down the track, shortens his length, quicker too, pushed out
outside the off stump, keeps low as well, tries to cut it away, but gets an inside edge

outside the off stump, pitched right up to the bat, he tries to drive it through the covers, gets bit of an outside edge and that goes through backward point, third-man rushes to his right by which time they get their second
outside the off stump, movement away from the bat as well, he tries to open the face of the bat to third-man, misses
on the leg stump this time, 132.3 km/hr, tries to flick it away, hits the pads and they are still able to run away for a leg-bye
slower ball, outside the leg stump, called a wide
pitched right up to the batsman, quick as well and Ryder tries to slog it away, bit of deviation and missed by the batsman
outside the off stump, length ball, opens the face of the bat and plays it down to third-man for a single
outside the off stump, pitched right up to the bat and he opens the face of the bat, does well to dig it out through third-man for a four!
